decisions.reason: As a prominently displayed and likely relatively low-cost adjacency, the accelerator still has option value for partnerships and future deal flow, so we would keep it open while its payoff remains uncertain.

The bio-based binder is less central to our machinery core and commercially more uncertain, but its continued standalone presentation suggests enough remaining upside to justify keeping it on the market for further learning.
This decontamination plant fits closely with our core decentralized treatment systems, stays visible on the home page, and therefore looks like a strong option worth retaining rather than abandoning.
